query: EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Sales YoY %], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "PY"), "w", CALCULATE([Share of All], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], 'Time Calc'[Period] IN {"YTD", "PY"}))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Static Fmt], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Fmt"), "d", CALCULATE([Dyn], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Fmt"), "n", CALCULATE([Total Sales], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Fmt"))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Time Calc'[Period], FILTER(VALUES('Time Calc'[Period]), 'Time Calc'[Period] IN {"Name", "IsSel"}), "a", [Total Sales], "b", [Units], "c", [Lines])
EVALUATE ROW("n", COUNTROWS('Time Calc'), "s", SELECTEDVALUE('Time Calc'[Period]))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(VAR x = [Total Sales] RETURN x, 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([TS Plus One], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Ref Self"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double", 'Scale'[Scale] = "Add Ten"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "YoY %", 'Scale'[Scale] = "Add Ten"))

EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Scale'[Scale], 'Time Calc'[Period], FILTER(VALUES('Time Calc'[Period]), 'Time Calc'[Period] IN {"Current", "Double", "Fmt"}), "v", [Static Fmt], "f", [_Static Fmt FormatString])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Time Calc'[Period], "v", [Dyn], "f", [_Dyn FormatString], "g", [_Dyn Self FormatString], "h", [Dyn Self])
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], TREATAS({"Double"}, 'Time Calc'[Period])))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Time Calc'[Period], "T"), FILTER(VALUES('Time Calc'[Period]), 'Time Calc'[Period] IN {"Current", "Double"}), "v", [Total Sales])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Time Calc'[Period], FILTER(VALUES('Time Calc'[Period]), 'Time Calc'[Period] IN {"Current", "Double"}), "s", SELECTEDVALUE('Time Calc'[Period]), "v", [Total Sales])
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(CALCULATE([Total Sales], KEEPFILTERS('Time Calc'[Period] = "Double")), 'Time Calc'[Period] IN {"Double", "YTD"}))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double", 'Date'[Year] = 2023), "w", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Sales), 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(CALCULATE([Units], FILTER(VALUES('Date'[Year]), [Total Sales] > 24500)), 'Time Calc'[Period] = "Double"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "dddd d mmmm yyyy"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", FORMAT(DATE(2024, 3, 5), "dddd d mmmm yyyy", "fr-FR"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], DATESINPERIOD('Date'[Date], DATE(2024, 3, 31), -10, DAY)))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(CALCULATE([Total Sales], DATEADD('Date'[Date], -1, QUARTER)), 'Date'[Year] = 2024, 'Date'[Quarter] = 1))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(CALCULATE([Total Sales], PARALLELPERIOD('Date'[Date], -1, YEAR)), 'Date'[Year] = 2024, 'Date'[Month] = 3))
EVALUATE ROW("v", RANKX(ALL(Product), [Avg Price], 45.5, DESC, DENSE))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(MAXX(Product, RANK(DENSE, ALL(Product), ORDERBY(Product[Price], DESC))), Product[ProductKey] = 5))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(MAXX(Product, ROWNUMBER(ALL(Product), ORDERBY(Product[Price], ASC))), Product[ProductKey] = 5))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(MAXX(OFFSET(-1, ALL(Product), ORDERBY(Product[ProductKey])), Product[Product]), Product[ProductKey] = 3))
EVALUATE ROW("v", MAXX(INDEX(1, ALL(Product), ORDERBY(Product[Price], DESC)), Product[Product]))
EVALUATE ROW("v", SUMX(WINDOW(1, ABS, 3, ABS, ALL(Product), ORDERBY(Product[ProductKey])), Product[Price]))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(SUMX(WINDOW(-1, REL, 0, REL, ALL(Product), ORDERBY(Product[ProductKey])), Product[Price]), Product[ProductKey] = 3))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CONCATENATEX(Product, Product[Product], ", ", Product[Price], DESC))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], CROSSFILTER(Sales[ProductKey], Product[ProductKey], NONE)))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALLEXCEPT(Sales, Sales[Channel])))
EVALUATE ROW("v", COUNTROWS(GROUPBY(Sales, Sales[Channel], "m", SUMX(CURRENTGROUP(), Sales[Qty]))))
EVALUATE ROW("v", COUNTROWS(SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(Product, "i", VALUES(Product[Category]), Product[Category], ASC)))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], TREATAS({"Toys", "Gear"}, Product[Category])))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], KEEPFILTERS(Product[Category] IN {"Toys"})))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE([Total Sales], NOT Product[Category] IN {"Toys"}))
EVALUATE ROW("t", INT(NOW()) = TODAY(), "u", INT(UTCNOW()) = UTCTODAY(), "d", ABS(NOW() - UTCNOW()) < 1)
